title: Senior Partnerships Lead
description_html:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 6/24/26

Anticipated Posting Close Date*: 8/31/26

*Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Senior Partnerships Lead - New York/East Coast | Remote

The Mission

We are building the engine that powers our partners’ growth. You are not here to "manage a channel." You are here to build a repeatable, scalable, and automated sales machine. You are a Builder-Seller: an expert who understands our technical product well enough to handle introductory, product focused conversations, and a hunter who knows how to drive the sales outcome.

Our ecosystem is primarily composed of VARs, MSPs, and SIs. Your success is defined by their success. You are the architect of that relationship.

The Scoreboard (Lag Measures)

Success is binary and measurable. You own these three outcomes:

  • New Bookings: You are accountable for the revenue generated through your partners.

  • Partner-Sourced Pipeline: You are the bridge. We don't want "fluff"; we want high-quality, qualified opportunities formally accepted by Fastly.

  • Active/Engaged Partners: We prioritize depth over breadth. You own the health and activity level of your partner portfolio.

The Daily Work (Lead Measures)

You don't get the outcomes above without the inputs. You are expected to operate with high agency on:

  • Co-Selling: You are in the room. You provide the technical and sales support to help partners close their deals.

  • Enablement: You ensure our partners’ teams are smarter than our competitors’. You deliver the playbooks, training, and technical confidence they need to lead with Fastly.

  • Co-Marketing: You execute "Marketing to, through, and with" your partners. You don't just "do" marketing; you drive pipeline-generating events and campaigns.

  • Machine Building: You identify the operational "bugs" in our deal registration or onboarding processes and you fix them. You don't wait for permission; you build the better way.

The Individual We Are Looking For

  • Deeply Technical, Commercially Driven: You can explain WAF, bot detection, and edge infrastructure to an engineer, then switch gears to explain the financial model (rebates, margins, MDF) to a business owner.

  • Builder-at-Heart: You prefer fixing an underlying process once for everyone over executing a manual workaround ten times. You use data to identify where the friction is.

  • High-Agency Owner: You don’t need a task list. You see a gap in partner engagement, you build the fix, and you report the result.

  • Ecosystem Fluent: You have significant experience working with VARs, MSPs, and SIs. You understand the unique economics of their business and how to make Fastly a foundational part of their service offering.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ Years Experience: Proven track record as a high-agency individual contributor in cloud, edge, or enterprise software.

  • Ecosystem Expert: 3+ years of direct experience driving revenue within the VAR/MSP/SI ecosystem.

  • Autonomy: A history of driving cross-functional alignment without formal authority.

  • Technical Credibility: Deep understanding of the modern stack: WAF, DDoS, Edge Infrastructure, and serverless compute.

Work Hours:

  • This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

This position is a remote role and open to candidates residing in the following locations:

East Coast Based (New York Preferred)

This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Salary:

The estimated range for On-Target Earnings for this role is $184,508.00 to $221,409.00. On-Target Earnings consists of a combination of annual base pay and sales compensation variable target. The standard pay split for this role (i.e. base pay vs. variable target (%) is 75/25.

Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

This role is eligible to participate in Fastly’s global sales compensation plan and may participate in Fastly’s equity program.

Benefits:

We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance. Family planning, mental health support along with Employee Assistance Program, Insurance (Life, Disability, and Accident), a Flexible Vacation policy and up to 18 days of accrued paid sick leave are there to help support our employees. We also offer 401(k) (including company match) and an Employee Stock Purchase Program. For 2026, we offer 12 paid local holidays, 12 paid company wellness days.

Why Fastly?

  • We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

  • We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful -- every day.

  • We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

We’re always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Fastly team. If you think you might be a fit please apply! A fully completed application and resume or CV are required when applying.

All job applications must be submitted through our official careers site at www.fastly.com/about/careers. We will never request sensitive information, such as your Social Security number, bank account or credit card information during the application process. All official communication will come from an @fastly.com or @recruiting.fastly.com email address.

Fastly is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity and to providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Our employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, family or parental status, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and federal or state disability laws, Fastly will provide reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact your Recruiter, or the Fastly Employee Relations team at candidateaccommodations@fastly.com or 501-287-4901.

Fastly collects and processes personal data submitted by job applicants in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Please see our privacy notice for job applicants.

title: Senior Manager, National Accounts
description_html:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Team

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of partnerships strategy at Angi. The National Accounts Strategy & Operations team is focused on supporting the identification and execution of growth strategies with the manufacturers, distributors, associations, networks and franchises that share relationships with Angi’s contractor customers.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, National Accounts will work with the team to drive National Accounts growth on the platform by diving into the data to find opportunities for improvement, putting together business cases, and driving large cross-functional change. You will devise strategy, build frameworks, structure solutions, manage projects and drive & measure results in the most critical areas of the business.

In this role, you will steward and/or support impactful strategic priorities; work with sales, account management, analytics, data science, operations and product teams to identify test ideas and execute. We are looking for highly motivated individuals who are seeking a role combining data-driven decision making with strategic initiatives to make an impact in Angi’s growth story for 2026 and beyond.

While this is a remote position, we are a global company and are looking for applicants located in eastern and central time zones to align with our team's working hours.

What you’ll do

  • Independently steward key strategic initiatives (or critical work streams within it) from initial concept and business case, through execution and success measurement — using AI tools to speed up research, modeling, and synthesis

  • Alongside an all-star team of peers and stakeholders, steer quantitative and qualitative research efforts into financial and operational drivers of Pro success and inform decision-making.

  • Provide regular updates on project progress, including measurable outcomes

  • Develop clear presentations summarizing findings and recommendations, leveraging AI tools to structure and refine communication efficiently

  • Establish effective communication channels for ongoing collaboration

  • Develop relationships with 3rd party business partners

  • Design and program manage joint partnership initiatives (e.g., integrations, go to market)

  • Build the playbook for sales and account management to materially improve partnership efficacy and economics

  • Provide thought partnership to the National Accounts Sales teams, in addition to cross-functional partners

  • Program manage large strategic changes that involve many teams and span multiple months, building cross-functional buy-in and collaboration, and providing updates and impact to senior leadership

  • Ensure smooth implementation and adaptation to new strategies

Who you are

  • Self-starter; someone who can manage and execute projects to completion. You have a bias for action.

  • Strong analytical skills – proficiency in modeling, basic SQL is a plus; comfortable using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) to augment analysis and accelerate output. You are able to synthesize complex data into actionable recommendations

  • First class communication skills

  • Maintain a careful balance between attention to detail and swift execution

  • Thrive with ambiguity

  • Team player; collaborates and influences effectively with cross-functional team members across the organization

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred.

  • 4-8 years of professional experience in consulting, finance, strategy, business development or operations experience

  • Strong analytical and execution background - demonstrated experience gathering data from various sources and driving strategic insight and decision-making

  • Proficiency with AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, or similar) to streamline research, writing, and analysis

  • Management consulting experience at a top firm strongly is a plus

  • Startup experience is a plus

  • A strong interest in Angi, home services, marketplaces and product-driven organizations

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K)

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world

title: Operations Analyst (Finance)
description_html:
Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote in Latin America.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Operations Analyst (Finance) to join Able’s growing Operations function and work closely with our Head of Finance. This is a hands-on role with two connected areas of ownership: finance execution and business insights. You’ll help keep the financial side of the business running reliably, from payroll and expenses to monthly close support, while also building the reporting and dashboards leadership needs to make better decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both getting the numbers right and figuring out what the numbers are telling us. You’ll have the opportunity to build processes, improve systems, and establish reporting capabilities that don’t exist today.

What We’re Looking For

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Finance Operations

  • Own payroll execution across LATAM and US systems, including contractor payments and payroll reconciliation.
  • Manage employee expenses, corporate cards, receipts, approvals, and reimbursements.
  • Support the monthly close process through journal entries, reconciliations, invoice tracking, and accounts receivable follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate, clean, and reconciled financial data across relevant systems.
  • Partner with the Head of Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and ad hoc financial analysis.
  • Identify discrepancies and investigate issues until the underlying cause is understood and resolved.

Data & Business Insights

  • Build and maintain Able’s leadership dashboard, covering key business metrics such as revenue, pipeline, retainer health, utilization, and cash.
  • Establish recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting for the leadership team.
  • Define and document business metrics so teams are working from consistent definitions and data.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis to support strategic and operational decisions.
  • Monitor data quality across systems such as HubSpot or Attio, Deel, and Greenhouse, and coordinate resolution of issues when they arise.
  • Turn fragmented data into clear, actionable insights for leadership and other stakeholders.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–6 years of experience in finance operations, financial analysis, business operations, or a related analytical role, ideally within a growing company.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll, expense management, and monthly financial close processes.
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced spreadsheet proficiency.
  • Experience working with SQL and/or business intelligence tools such as Metabase, Looker Studio, or similar.
  • Experience building dashboards, reports, or analyses for leadership audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of comfort working with financial data.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Deel, Justworks, HubSpot, Attio, Greenhouse, or comparable systems.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership and the ability to manage work independently in a growing, evolving environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting both US and LATAM payroll or finance operations.
  • Experience working in a startup, services business, or other lean operating environment.
  • Experience establishing reporting processes or analytics capabilities from scratch.
  • Experience with financial planning, forecasting, or budgeting.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar as part of your day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

We’re looking for someone who brings more than technical skills. The right person for this role is:

  • AI-fluent. You already use AI tools in your day-to-day work to analyze information, automate repetitive tasks, draft materials, and work more efficiently.
  • A builder. You’re comfortable creating processes and systems where there isn’t a playbook yet. You’d rather ship a useful first version and improve it than wait for perfection.
  • Detail-oriented. You understand that financial operations require precision. When the numbers don’t tie, you want to know why.
  • A clear communicator. You surface problems early, ask questions when something is unclear, and communicate what you know — and what you don’t.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Able is growing and evolving quickly. You’ll help shape the processes and systems you’ll eventually own.

Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology.

This position is 100% remote in Latin America. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement.

As a team member, you can expect:

  • To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed.
  • Payments made in USD.
  • 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years.
  • Wellness + Remote Stipend
  • AI Voucher

About Able

Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth.

We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster.

Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you.

Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together.

This position is 100% remote within LatAm.

What you’ll be doing

We are seeking someone who enjoys working at the cutting edge where Computer Vision meets Logic. You will be responsible for the "eyes" and the "brain" of our system—extracting complex data from visual documents and then orchestrating how that data is used by Large Language Models.

In short, someone who likes:

  • Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis.
  • Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses.
  • Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it.
  • Prompt Engineering & Logic: Crafting complex prompts and control flows to ensure models interpret financial charts and layouts accurately without hallucinating.
  • Cost & Scale: Applying a cost-optimization mindset (batch processing, model selection) to ensure our vision and orchestration layers are economically viable.

What we’re looking for

We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps.

Ideally, they would also have:

  • LLM Orchestration (Must Have): Deep experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks. You know how to manage context windows, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
  • Multimodal AI Experience: Hands-on experience integrating state-of-the-art vision models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and embedding models (CLIP).
  • Document Intelligence Specialist: Familiarity with specialized models (e.g., Donut, Pix2Struct) and tools like Unstructured.io or Docling.
  • PDF Processing Mastery: Mastery over tools like PyMuPDF or pdfplumber for native element extraction.
  • Python ML Stack: Strong proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning vision or language models, specifically to improve accuracy on domain-specific artifacts like financial charts or tables.
  • Domain Knowledge: Prior experience handling documents in the Real Estate or Finance sectors.

title: Management Consulting Matcher
description_html:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a Toptal Management Consulting Matcher, you will be working directly with Toptal’s clients to understand their needs, custom-match them with Management Consultants from our talent network, and provide support during the matching process, throughout the engagement, and beyond.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Gather requirements and consult with clients to ensure needs are understood.
  • Define job descriptions, talent responsibilities, and requirements.
  • Search talent profiles, shortlist candidates, and send availability requests.
  • Confirm talent availability, screen job applications, and select candidates.
  • Introduce candidates to clients, communicating technical and cultural fit.
  • Customize talent rates, adjust commitment types, and schedule engagement dates.
  • Obtain feedback on talent and maintain detailed platform documentation.
  • Provide advice and guidance to Management Consultants in the network.
  • Investigate disputes and collaborate cross-functionally in the resolution process.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision.
  • Familiarize yourself with the team’s tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Shadow matching calls and learn about the matching process with your TopPal.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Take on your first clients and manage their engagements with Toptal.
  • Learn about supporting teams and how they contribute to the company’s success.
  • Work closely with individual Management Consultants and our talent network.
  • Become proficient with Toptal’s platform.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Matching, Sales, and Talent Operations.
  • Build a mature client portfolio.
  • Establish direct connections with top talents in our network.
  • Resolve any client-talent disputes which may arise in your client portfolio.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Become eligible to take on Toptal’s major accounts, including top-tier brands and clients.
  • Understand best practices and share effective strategies with the team.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Act as a subject matter expert on management consulting matching.
  • Continue to promote an environment of teamwork and collaboration.
  • Offer insights and ways to improve the success of a Matching lifecycle based on feedback, experience, and data insights.
  • Have started taking on initiatives to improve operations, establishing the needed infrastructure for scale.
  • Participate in onboarding newcomers and helping them learn about best practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree is required.
  • Full-time availability during EST or PST working hours.
  • 5+ years in Management Consulting (top-tier, or reputable boutique firm), or equivalent strategic advisory experience.
  • Hands-on experience across multiple consulting practices — e.g., strategy, finance, operations, marketing, people/HR, and technology — or a strong generalist track record spanning several of these areas.
  • Strong adaptability to learn and execute in new areas of expertise — e.g., Product Management, Project Management, Design, Digital Marketing.
  • Ability to understand ambiguous business needs and translate them to a consultant’s responsibilities and skills.
  • Excellent communication, relationship development and emotional intelligence skills to qualify a consulting project, and to assess fit with the best consultant or team of consultants.
  • Understanding of business strategy and management consulting concepts, playbooks and frameworks (MBA is an advantage but not required).
  • Ability to quickly adopt new processes and technologies.
  • Ability to adhere to tight deadlines and thrive under pressure.
  • Strong strategic thinking skills.
  • Self-starter who can execute with limited guidance.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Client Advisor
description_html:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk — and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request isn’t the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isn’t the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Account Executive
description_html:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll have the opportunity to target and close net new accounts, as well as re-engage dormant accounts. Success in this role comes from your skills in researching potential customers, strategically engaging them, aligning Toptal’s value with their needs, and consistently closing new business. This is a full sales cycle role, which means you will be responsible for setting your own meetings through your prospecting and outreach.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Prospect, educate, qualify, and close leads and opportunities by engaging dormant accounts and performing lead-generation activities into new targeted accounts. Additionally, manage inbound leads, as required.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to convey Toptal’s vision, identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.
  • Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.
  • As you become more comfortable in the role, you’ll help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • While exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.
  • Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
  • Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.
  • Establish a career path for advancement.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate will bring at least 1 year of closing experience.
  • You are persistent. Being rejected by prospective clients can be a common occurrence in this role. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks. Being enthusiastic, ambitious, and having a positive mindset will play a key role in your success.
  • You are naturally curious. You have a strong desire to understand people, their problems, companies, and industries. If/when you come across a complex issue, you can understand and explain them to clients.
  • You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business. To succeed at Toptal, you need to be a world-class individual contributor. Part of this includes being able to take ownership of your accounts, successes, and failures.
  • You are a go-getter. We are looking for self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts and think about target accounts as their own business. You aren’t afraid to do the work required to reach your goals by following a process and being creative.
  • You don’t take yourself too seriously; you have a sense of humor and are comfortable with sarcasm. This position does sit on our Sales teams, after all.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

title: Senior Software Enginner (Full-stack Node + React)
description_html:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and evolve the full stack systems that power Airtm’s financial products. You’ll work within one of our autonomous product pods, taking ownership of projects end-to-end, from technical design through production, and mentoring the engineers around you.

Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices deployed on Kubernetes, paired with React front ends. You’ll work across the entire stack, backend and frontend, as needed to deliver on your pod’s goals, collaborating with engineers in other pods when initiatives cross boundaries. AI-assisted development is core to how we build software: you’ll be expected to use AI coding tools fluently to move faster without sacrificing quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Design: Lead the design of medium-to-large features across the stack, document decisions, and anticipate edge cases and long-term maintainability
  • Full Stack Development: Build and maintain TypeScript/Node.js microservices, event handlers, and cronjobs, as well as the React UIs that consume them, powering our core financial flows
  • AI-Assisted Development: Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your daily workflow, from scaffolding and refactoring to test generation and code review, while maintaining a high bar for correctness and judgment about when and how much to rely on them
  • Project Ownership: Break down complex problems into actionable work across multiple services and UIs; drive delivery from design through deployment
  • Code Quality: Write well-tested, maintainable code; conduct thorough code reviews (including AI-generated code) and hold a high bar for the team
  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, including on effective and responsible use of AI tooling; share knowledge and elevate the team’s technical practices
  • Cross-Pod Collaboration: Coordinate with engineers in other pods when work crosses service boundaries; contribute code to shared services following established ownership guidelines
  • On-Call: Participate in on-call rotation for services the pod owns; lead incident response and post-incident reviews
  • Technical Debt: Proactively identify and address technical debt; balance short-term delivery with long-term health of the systems

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated full stack range (backend services and frontend UIs)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for building production services
  • Proficiency in React for building production-facing UIs (state management, component design, performance)
  • Experience designing and building REST or GraphQL APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL or similar), modeling, query optimization, and migrations
  • Familiarity with event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (Kafka, SQS, or similar)
  • Experience working in a microservices environment
  • Hands-on, day-to-day experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Zed’s Agentic editing, or similar) for coding, debugging, and code review; comfort with prompt/context engineering and sound judgment about validating AI-generated output
  • Strong grasp of software design principles: separation of concerns, error handling, testing strategies
  • Experience writing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Comfort operating in a cloud environment (AWS preferred), understanding of deployments, logs, and basic infrastructure concepts
  • Strong communication skills; proactive about sharing progress, blockers, and technical risks

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered features into products (RAG, agents, tool calling, prompt pipelines)
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and container-based deployments
  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial systems
  • Experience working with GraphQL (schema design, federation, or tooling)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD)
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions

What We Look For

Beyond the technical skills, we’re looking for engineers who:

  • Take ownership, they drive their work to completion and communicate early when something is at risk
  • Write code for the next engineer, clean, tested, and documented, whether they or an AI tool wrote the first draft
  • Improve the team around them, through reviews, mentorship, and knowledge sharing
  • Collaborate across boundaries, they engage other pods constructively when work crosses service lines
  • Have good technical judgment, they balance pragmatism with quality, know when to push back on scope, and know when (and when not) to lean on AI tooling

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Strategic Account Manager
description_html:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location: Remote

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Strategic Account Manager on our APAC - Oceania team, you'll be the trusted partner that our largest and most complex customers rely on to get the most out of Cloudbeds. You'll manage a focused portfolio of high-value properties across Asia-Pacific, bringing deep hospitality expertise and a consultative approach to every interaction — from strategic business reviews to on-site property visits. This isn't just account management; it's true strategic partnership. You'll help hoteliers make smarter decisions, optimize their operations, and grow their business, while playing a key role in shaping how Cloudbeds shows up in one of our most dynamic and demanding markets

Our AM Team is responsible for identifying upsell opportunities for ACV expansion and minimizing customer churn. AMs will act as the first point of contact for all things related to Cloudbeds. They are responsible for guiding clients through their customer journey while providing recommendations on how to best improve their business in order to achieve success. As a Strategic AM you will make the motto “more reservations, happier guests” a reality by providing strategic guidance to our customers around the world and helping them achieve their “Success Outcomes.”

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Manage a focused portfolio of Cloudbeds' largest and most complex hotel customers in APAC, serving as their primary point of contact and strategic advisor for everything Cloudbeds-related
  • Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior hotel stakeholders through regular touchpoints, strategic business reviews, and on-site property visits across Thailand
  • Drive net dollar retention by identifying upsell and expansion opportunities and implementing proactive churn reduction strategies across your portfolio
  • Act as a true strategic partner — leveraging your hospitality expertise to provide tailored recommendations that help customers optimize their revenue, operations, and commercial performance
  • Manage complex customer escalations and collaborate cross-functionally with Support, Sales, and Product teams to ensure timely and effective resolution
  • Analyze customer data and usage trends to identify opportunities for deeper product adoption and improved business outcomes
  • Gather and synthesize customer feedback and requirements, communicating insights internally to help shape the future direction of the Cloudbeds platform
  • Conduct on-site visits to customer properties across Oceania/Asia Pacific, traveling locally an estimated one time per month, with the possibility of more extensive travel estimated to be once per quarter.

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • Bring 7+ years of hospitality industry experience in senior operational or commercial roles — Revenue Manager, Director of Revenue, Operations Manager, General Manager, or similar — within hotels or hospitality properties in Oceania
  • Demonstrate advanced understanding of hotel operations and commercial strategy, including revenue management, distribution, pricing, budgeting, and property management systems (PMS)
  • Possess deep experience in the Oceania hospitality market with a strong grasp of regional customer expectations, business practices, and the nuances of managing high-value hotel relationships
  • Deliver exceptional communication with executive presence, credibility, and the ability to influence and present effectively at all levels of a hotel organization
  • Demonstrate a track record of managing complex, high-value customer portfolios with strong organizational skills, proactive follow-through, and a results-driven mindset
  • Show ability to learn and deeply understand technology platforms and translate technical concepts into practical, strategic recommendations for hoteliers

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

  • Experience with SaaS platforms or hospitality technology (PMS, RMS, channel managers, or similar tools) — either as a power user or in a customer-facing tech role
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM and account management tools
  • Based in or with significant market experience in Phuket or other key Thai resort markets

title: Senior Manager, Sales Engineering
description_html:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineering Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Sales Engineering Director, Greater Asia in the Solutions Consulting department. In this role, you will lead a high-performing Sales Engineering team to design and present comprehensive technical solutions that drive revenue and customer success. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional leadership, product teams, and account executives to support the entire sales lifecycle and influence product enhancements based on strategic market feedback.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Partner with Regional Directors, product, and engineering teams to close deals and deliver high-impact strategic solutions for customers and partners

  • Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing Sales Engineering team within the geography

  • Collaborate with sales leadership and customers to design and present comprehensive business solutions

  • Contribute directly to product development and enhancements for existing solutions based on market feedback

  • Support Geo Account Executives throughout the entire opportunity sales lifecycle

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

  • Extensive experience in presales (typically 15+ years) with a background in managing Sales Engineering teams (typically 3-5 years)

  • Proven ability to enable and lead teams in delivering high-quality product and solution demonstrations

  • Expert-level experience refining key sales engineering processes, including discovery, technical qualification, and proof-of-value

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leading sales engineering teams in effectively demonstrating and positioning enterprise AI/ML solutions to accelerate the sales lifecycle

  • Experience promoting complex products and business solutions at major conferences, forums, and seminars

  • Active participation in regional industry events or organizations as a recognized thought leader

We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:

  • Various health plans
  • Time off plans for vacation and sick time
  • Parental leave options
  • Retirement options
  • Education reimbursement
  • In-office perks, and more!

Role

We are looking for a Partner Business Manager to join our Global Partner Ecosystem team. This is a hybrid role based in Canberra with a requirement to be in the office 3 days a week, reporting to the Senior Director, Partner Sales. The senior partner business manager’s core purpose is to build and scale high-performing partner relationships by aligning joint strategy, enablement, and go-to-market execution to drive mutual revenue growth. Their overall impact is for healthy partner engagement, measured through pipeline, faster deal velocity, service creation, expanded market coverage, renewal success and improved customer outcomes.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Joint regional GTM sales execution with Sales Director
  • Regional partner strategy & growth plan
  • Partner activation (enablement, sales engagement & pipeline development)
  • Partner performance management and forecast governance

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. You adapt to what’s needed, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You operate with urgency. You understand that in a high-growth environment, speed and quality are not mutually exclusive. You have a relentless focus on execution and a bias for action, delivering high-impact results quickly to win for the customer and the team.
  • You champion simplicity. You are skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, simple, and actionable plans. You are a precise communicator who brings clarity and focus to every interaction.
  • You think at scale. You connect your day-to-day work to the larger company mission and think globally. You build solutions, processes, and teams that are not just effective today but are built to last and support a high-growth, global organization.
  • You are resilient and adaptable. You view change as an opportunity and setbacks as temporary. You maintain composure and focus in high-pressure situations, guiding yourself and your team through complexity with a steady, positive hand.
  • You lead with integrity. You do the right thing, even when it’s hard. You hold yourself and others to a high standard of accountability and build trust by matching your words with consistent, transparent action.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 8+ years in partner/channel sales, alliances, or regional partner management - deep understanding of the Federal Public Sector landscape, including the associated partner network, procurement frameworks, and seasonal acquisition timelines
  • Experience building joint GTM plans with regional sales leadership and executing co-sell motions (account mapping, deal reviews, close plans)

  • Experience in network, cyber and cloud security solutions
  • Willingness to travel within the region as required to support partners and the sales team

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experienced in Public Sector industry vertical

title: Senior Brand & Celebrity Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at PURELEI GmbH
description_html:
Deine Mission

Als Senior Brand Creator Marketing Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest du, wie PURELEI durch Creator- und Brand-Partnerschaften auf internationaler Ebene wahrgenommen wird. Du arbeitest nicht auf Performance-Ebene einzelner Kampagnen, sondern auf der strategischen Ebene: Wie stärken wir Brand Preference, Unaided Awareness und die Attribute, für die PURELEI steht – Emotionen und Verbindung – nachhaltig und messbar über Creator- und Brand-Kooperationen.

Du verhandelst und gestaltest Top-Level-Partnerschaften, denkst Kampagnen von Anfang bis Ende strategisch mit und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis fundierter Erfolgsmessung statt Bauchgefühl. Dabei bewegst du dich sicher zwischen internen Stakeholdern, internationalen Partnern und unterschiedlichen kulturellen Kontexten.

Die Position berichtet an unseren Team Lead Creator- & Brand Collaborations und ist hybrid möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz zu Pflichtterminen an unserem Standort in Mannheim. Gelegentliche Reisetätigkeit (z. B. zu Creator-Events oder Partner-Meetings) gehört dazu.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Brand Preference & Awareness: Du entwickelst und steuerst Strategien, die Brand Preference und Unaided Brand Awareness von PURELEI messbar steigern.
  • Strategische Partnerschaften: Du identifizierst, verhandelst und gestaltest Kooperationen mit Creators und Brand-Partnern auf internationalem Top-Level – von der Vertragsgestaltung bis zur laufenden Beziehungspflege.
  • Kampagnenverantwortung: Du führst Kampagnen und Projekte auf strategischer Ebene, von der Konzeption bis zur Erfolgsmessung, und stellst sicher, dass sie auf unsere übergeordneten Markenziele einzahlen.
  • Search & Brand Signals: Du behältst den Google Search Trend als Indikator für Markenrelevanz im Blick und leitest daraus Maßnahmen ab.
  • Brand Attribute Building: Du sorgst dafür, dass Kooperationen gezielt auf die Markenattribute einzahlen, für die PURELEI steht– allen voran Emotionen und Verbindung.
  • Datenbasierte Erfolgsmessung: Du baust die nötige Transparenz auf, um Brand- und Creator-Partnerschaften sauber gegen KPIs wie Brand Preference, Awareness und Search Trends zu bewerten.
  • Stakeholder- & Beziehungsmanagement: Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen internen Stakeholdern und internationalen Partnern und trittst auch in anspruchsvollen Verhandlungssituationen mit Standing auf.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Marketing, Kommunikation oder Brand Management.
  • Erfahrung: mehrjährige Erfahrung in Brand Marketing, Creator Marketing oder vergleichbaren Bereichen mit strategischem Fokus.
  • Vertrags- & Verhandlungsexpertise: Du verhandelst sicher auf internationalem Top-Level und bringst nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Vertragsgestaltung mit.
  • Kampagnen- & Projektmanagement: Du steuerst komplexe Kampagnen und Projekte auf strategischer Ebene souverän von Anfang bis Ende.
  • Datenaffinität: Du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis fundierter, datenbasierter Erfolgsmessung statt Intuition.
  • Standing & Verhandlungssicherheit: Du trittst auch gegenüber erfahrenen internationalen Partnern selbstbewusst und überzeugend auf.
  • Diskretion & Urteilsvermögen: Du gehst mit sensiblen Informationen und Partnerschaften verantwortungsbewusst um.
  • Belastbarkeit: Du behältst auch unter Unsicherheit und in dynamischen Situationen einen klaren Kopf.
  • Beziehungsmanagement: Du baust und pflegst Beziehungen auf internationalem Top-Level nachhaltig.
  • Cross-kulturelle Kompetenz: Du kommunizierst sicher und sensibel über kulturelle Grenzen hinweg.
  • Stakeholder-Führung: Du führst interne Stakeholder auch ohne disziplinarische Verantwortung sicher durch komplexe Entscheidungsprozesse.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Warum PURELEI?

Wir leben Aloha: Bei uns ist Aloha kein Marketing-Gag, sondern gelebte Kultur. Spaß an der Arbeit, respektvolles Miteinander von Foundern bis Praktikant:innen und ehrliches, wertschätzendes Feedback sind bei uns Alltag.

Wachstum & Entwicklung: Wir fordern dich und fördern dich. Mit deinem persönlichen Weiterbildungsbudget, Coaching auf Augenhöhe und spannenden Projekten kannst du über dich hinauswachsen.

Work-Life Aloha: Unbefristete Verträge (je nach Position), bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub, Vaterschaftsurlaub, Workations, Buddyprogramm und flexibles / hybrides Arbeiten (je nach Position) sorgen für ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du dich dauerhaft wohlfühlst.

Team & Fun: Coole Teamevents, regelmäßige Unternehmensevents, Jobrad, Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm – wir feiern Erfolge zusammen und leben echtes #TEAMPURELEI.

Familie & Support: Kita-Zuschuss bis 50% und ein Umfeld, das Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Karriere ernst nimmt.

Extras, die Freude machen: Täglich frisches Obst, Kaffee, Softdrinks & Wasser, Mitarbeiter-Codes, Corporate Benefits und monatlicher PURELEI-Shop-Gutschein.

Bei uns bist du richtig, wenn du wachsen, gestalten und mit Fokus, Teamgeist und Mut Dinge verändern willst – ganz im Aloha-Spirit.

title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Govradar
description_html:
Warum diese Rolle?

GovRadar ist eine cloudbasierte Software zur automatisierten Erstellung öffentlicher Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Lösung sparen Behörden bis zu 90% Zeit in der Vergabevorbereitung, damit Investitionen schneller in die Umsetzung kommen.

Wir befähigen die öffentliche Verwaltung – für eine zukunftssichere Gesellschaft.


Deine Mission

Als (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager bist du die treibende Kraft zur zielgerichteten Erweiterung unseres Teams und spielst damit eine entscheidende Rolle für unser zukünftiges Wachstum. Du bist Teil des CEO Office und für Kandidaten, wie auch unsere Hiring Manager, die zentrale Ansprechperson im gesamten Recruiting Prozess.
Für diese Herausforderungen brauchen wir dich:

  • Verantwortung des end-to-end Recruiting-Prozesses, von Hiring Strategie über Stellenausschreibung und Pipeline Management bis zur Vertragsunterschrift
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Employer Branding, um GovRadar zur ersten Wahl für Top-Talente im GovTech-Sektor zu etablieren
  • Active Sourcing und Aufbau qualifizierter Talent-Pipelines für verschiedene Rollen in Product & Engineering, GTM und Operations
  • Sicherstellung einer effizienten und wertschätzenden Experience für Kandidaten und Hiring Manager
  • Koordinierung von externen Stakeholdern, wie z.B. Headhunter für ausgewählte Positionen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von skalierbaren Prozessen mit dem richtigen Mix aus AI/Automatisierung und Human Touch


Dein Profil

Must have’s

  • Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (min. C1) und professioneller Umgang auf Englisch (min. B2)
  • Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Active Sourcing & Recruiting mit end-to-end Prozess-Verantwortung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Leadership / C-Level
  • Umgang mit Tech- & Business-Profilen: du bist nachweislich in der Lage, Kandidaten mit unterschiedlichsten Backgrounds zu begeistern, zu qualifizieren und mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Spaß am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld: du hast bereits in einem Startup gearbeitet und siehst schnelle Veränderungen und fehlende Strukturen als spannende Herausforderung
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten, nimmst proaktiv Herausforderungen an und holst dir an den entsprechenden Stellen Unterstützung dazu
  • Daten- und Tech-Affinität: du steuerst deine Pipeline datengetrieben und suchst proaktiv nach Potentialen für Automatisierung/AI
  • Aufbau von Strukturen: du hast skalierbare Prozesse nicht nur angewendet, sondern bereits selbst von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung mitgestaltet
Nice to have’s
  • Talent Acquisition als neue Funktion von Grund auf aufgebaut & etabliert
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Teamtailor als ATS
  • Vernetzung im Münchner SaaS-Startup-Ökosystem
  • Berührungspunkte mit dem öffentlichen Sektor oder GovTech-Unternehmen


Was dich erwartet

  • Team & Kultur - ein hochmotiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Ownership - ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet und die Möglichkeit, eine neue Funktion nach deinen Ideen und Vorstellungen aufzubauen
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung - ein attraktives Fixgehalt zuzüglich performance-basierter Boni, die deine Erfolge belohnen
  • Kontinuierliches Lernen - Weiterentwicklung als Teil deiner individuellen Ziele, unterstützt durch dezidiertes Budget und monatliches Coaching mit deiner Führungskraft
  • Flexibles Arbeiten - hybrides Modell (3 Tage im Büro direkt am Hauptbahnhof), flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit auf Workation
  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit - du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Leadership Team an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation
  • Gesellschaftlicher Impact - trage aktiv dazu bei, den Staat in Deutschland handlungsfähiger zu machen und das Vertrauen der Menschen in die Demokratie zu stärken
